pages.text: Random and unstable Ages have a high chance to pick up exotic surface themes: hex plates, wire cells, separators, cables, fractal cubes, or light fissures. These are cosmetic and structural anomalies inspired by alien worlds.

$(item)Lost Pages$() identify into weighted random symbols. Standard pages are common, while extremely valuable pages such as city terrain, biospheres, dense ores, and $(thing)Age Effect$() pages are intentionally rare.
